MOD = 1000000007

class VecType:
    def __init__(self):
        self.vals = [0] * 30

class MatType:
    def __init__(self):
        self.mat = [[0] * 30 for _ in range(30)]

def getVal(num, baseK):
    if num < baseK:
        return num
    return (num + getVal(num // baseK, baseK)) % baseK

def multiplyMat(a, b, baseK):
    res = MatType()
    for i in range(baseK):
        for j in range(baseK):
            res.mat[i][j] = 0
            for l in range(baseK):
                res.mat[i][j] += (a.mat[i][l] * b.mat[l][j]) % MOD
            res.mat[i][j] %= MOD
    return res

def multiplyMatVec(m, v, baseK):
    res = VecType()
    for i in range(baseK):
        res.vals[i] = 0
        for j in range(baseK):
            res.vals[i] += (v.vals[j] * m.mat[i][j]) % MOD
        res.vals[i] %= MOD
    return res

def precompute(totalN, baseK, matricesArr, invMatricesArr):
    E = [[MatType() for _ in range(40)] for _ in range(200)]
    EI = [[MatType() for _ in range(40)] for _ in range(200)]
    for i in range(baseK):
        E[0][i] = matricesArr[i]
        EI[0][i] = invMatricesArr[i]
    LOG = 0
    t = totalN
    while t > 0:
        LOG += 1
        t //= baseK
    for j in range(1, LOG + 1):
        for i in range(baseK):
            E[j][0] = E[j - 1][0]
            EI[j][0] = EI[j - 1][0]
        for l in range(1, baseK):
            E[j][0] = multiplyMat(E[j - 1][l], E[j][0], baseK)
            EI[j][0] = multiplyMat(EI[j][0], EI[j - 1][l], baseK)
        for i in range(1, baseK):
            E[j][i] = multiplyMat(E[j - 1][i - 1], multiplyMat(E[j][i - 1], EI[j - 1][i - 1], baseK), baseK)
            EI[j][i] = multiplyMat(E[j - 1][i - 1], multiplyMat(EI[j][i - 1], EI[j - 1][i - 1], baseK), baseK)
    return E, EI, LOG

def solveVec(n, v, at, E, baseK):
    if n == 0:
        return v
    w = getVal(n // baseK, baseK)
    v = solveVec(n // baseK, v, at + 1, E, baseK)
    for i in range(n % baseK):
        v = multiplyMatVec(E[at][(w + i) % baseK], v, baseK)
    return v

def main():
    totalN, baseK = map(int, input().split())
    matricesArr = [MatType() for _ in range(30)]
    invMatricesArr = [MatType() for _ in range(30)]
    currentVec = VecType()
    for i in range(baseK):
        currentVec.vals[i] = 1
        for j in range(baseK):
            for l in range(baseK):
                if j == l:
                    matricesArr[i].mat[j][l] = 1
                    invMatricesArr[i].mat[j][l] = 1
                elif j == i:
                    matricesArr[i].mat[j][l] = 1
                    invMatricesArr[i].mat[j][l] = -1
                else:
                    matricesArr[i].mat[j][l] = 0
                    invMatricesArr[i].mat[j][l] = 0
    E, EI, LOG = precompute(totalN, baseK, matricesArr, invMatricesArr)
    currentVec = solveVec(totalN, currentVec, 0, E, baseK)
    totalSum = sum(currentVec.vals[:baseK]) % MOD
    totalSum -= 1
    totalSum %= MOD
    while totalSum % (baseK - 1) != 0:
        totalSum += MOD
        totalSum %= MOD
    print(totalSum // (baseK - 1))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
